description: SASRec encodes interaction sequences with item embeddings, learned positional embeddings, and causal self-attention blocks. Each position predicts the next item through a dot product with shared item embeddings. Attention lets predictions draw on recent actions or longer histories. Source: [Self-Attentive Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781v1).
motivation: The paper balances the simplicity of short-range Markov models with the longer-range modeling ability of recurrent networks. Despite the supplied title, SASRec is not a dedicated cold-start method: unseen items lack trained ID embeddings, and users without histories provide no personalized sequence context.
implementation_notes: The paper uses residual connections, layer normalization, dropout, Adam, and sampled binary cross-entropy with one negative per valid position. For this task, start from sasrec_perdataset, preserve all four dataset routes and fixed splits, use preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42, and retain DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']. Respect SASREC_EPOCHS=200 unless explicitly changed within the search. Select using macro validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator; no improvement has been measured here. Save artifacts beneath the trial directory and update the predictor writer whenever inference changes. Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis), with measured metrics and definitions. Use only available histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps.
pseudocode:
for category in four_categories:
    load_fixed_splits(category, preprocessing_seed=0)
    initialize_sasrec(training_seed=42)
    for epoch in configured_epochs(default=200):
        for _, sequence, positive, negative in train_loader:
            features = model.log2feats(sequence)
            pos = model.predict_score(features, positive)
            neg = model.predict_score(features, negative)
            valid = positive != 0
            loss = mean(softplus(-pos[valid]) + softplus(neg[valid]))
            optimizer_step(loss)
    save_model_config_and_weights_under_trial(category)
write_matching_predictor_with_dataset_routing()
# Host independently evaluates working/predict.py.

originality.positive: The original paper established a compelling self-attention approach to sequential recommendation.
originality.negative: Reusing SASRec adds little novelty relative to the required SASRec baseline. Scores use a 1–10 scale.

future_potential.positive: Available item text could support a future content-aware extension for sparse items.
future_potential.negative: That extension is not part of vanilla SASRec, and its validation benefit remains untested.

code_difficulty.positive: The existing baseline and compatibility contract support straightforward implementation.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct masking, negative sampling, checkpoint loading, and predictor consistency still require care.
